subject: Renewal proposal: 36-month prepay to lock pricing + ramp plan
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chang <laura.chang@nimbus-analytics.com>, Procurement <procurement@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-05-10T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal proposal: 36-month prepay to lock pricing + ramp plan

Hi Laura / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Based on what we discussed — your desire to lock list pricing for the next few years and reduce month-to-month volatility as usage ramps — I’ve attached a concise term sheet with a 36-month prepay option that accomplishes both goals. High level:

- 36-month firm rate lock at current list prices (no list increases during term)
- Blended prepay discount: 12% effective across 3 years if paid upfront in full
- Ramp schedule: Year 1 commit = 40% of projected annual consumption; Year 2 = 30%; Year 3 = 30%
- Annual true-up windows (30 days after each anniversary) with credit/charge mechanics
- Invoicing: single invoice on signature (preferred) or annual invoicing by agreement
- Standard 60-day termination for convenience with pro-rata refund schedule for unused prepay (less early-termination fee)

I’m attaching the Redwood_3yr_prepay_term_sheet.pdf and a draft SOW for the initial integration milestones. If the economics look good I can loop in Marissa and legal to move to DocuSign.

Questions to help finalize the term sheet:
1) Do you prefer a single up-front prepay or an annual prepay schedule?
2) Any constraints from procurement on refund/true-up language?

If it helps, we can also provide a simplified 24-month option with a slightly smaller blended discount (8%) — I included that as an alternate in the term sheet.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: Redwood_3yr_prepay_term_sheet.pdf, NIMBUS_SOW_draft.docx

From: Laura Chang <laura.chang@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: 36-month prepay to lock pricing + ramp plan

Aditya — thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft. A few clarifying items from procurement and finance: 

- We need the invoice cadence to match our fiscal calendar. A single up-front invoice is OK if you can provide a clear refund/true-up schedule; procurement will want visibility into the pro-rata calculation in the termination scenario.
- Can you confirm how you handle overage billing between true-ups? If usage exceeds prepay allocation mid-year, is the delta billed at list or at a committed rate?
- Our CFO is asking whether we can get the price lock but split the prepay into annual payments (still committed) — that helps our cash flow.
- Also: any possibility of an additional term discount if we expand the scope to cover embeddings at scale in year 2? That’s still contingent on engineering signing off.

If you can send an updated term sheet that shows (A) invoice cadence options, (B) an explicit overage billing rule, and (C) a 3-year signature incentive (e.g., extra 3% discount if executed within 30 days), that would help move this forward.

Laura Chang
Head of Procurement — Nimbus Analytics
laura.chang@nimbus-analytics.com | +1 (646) 555-0199

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-05-14T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal: 36-month prepay to lock pricing + ramp plan

Marissa / Vivek / Sergio — forwarding Laura's note from Nimbus. Key asks:
- Confirm invoice cadence options (single up-front vs annual installments)
- Overages: procurement wants clarity on rate applied between true-ups
- They asked for an execution incentive (extra 3% if signed within 30 days)
- Possible expansion to include embeddings in year 2 (upsell upside)

My suggested reply: offer both invoice options (single up-front or annual committed invoices) and specify overages billed at the committed blended rate until the next true-up; allow a 30-day signature incentive of an additional 3% discount off the blended rate if they sign by June 13. To be competitive, I’d be willing to stack an extra 5% discretionary discount on the 12% blended if legal approves (effectively 16% blended) but would like sign-off before promising.

Can you confirm guardrails for the discretionary discount and whether we should sign DocuSign terms with an annual invoice option (procurement-friendly) or push for single up-front? I’ve attached the SOW draft again.

Thanks,
Aditya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-16T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal: 36-month prepay to lock pricing + ramp plan

Aditya — quick notes from GTM and renewals:
- Approve offering both invoice cadences. Procurement will prefer annual invoices but single up-front is acceptable when they have the balance sheet to do it.
- Overages: agree to bill overages at the committed blended rate until the next true-up; we should include an explicit example calculation in the term sheet to avoid ambiguity.
- On discretionary discount: I can approve up to 7% additional (so 19% total effective off list for the 3-yr if we stack the 12% + 7%) if legal confirms the refund/term language is safe and we get signature within 30 days. We should not exceed 7% without VP-level approval.
- Offer the 3% execution incentive in addition to the above (i.e., combineable) to close faster.

Next steps: Aditya, send an updated term sheet showing both invoice options, the overage rule with worked example, and two price scenarios: (A) standard 12% blended for 3-yr, (B) 12% blended + 7% discretionary (requires legal ok & 30-day signature), plus a callout for the 3% execution bonus. I’ll loop legal for a quick review once you send.

Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Renewals | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0177

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chang <laura.chang@nimbus-analytics.com>, Procurement <procurement@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Updated proposal and next steps — DocuSign included

Laura — thanks for the clear asks. Attached is an updated term sheet that incorporates Marissa's guidance and internal approvals. Summary of the revised offer:

- 36-month prepay with price lock at current list for the entire term.
- Base blended discount (3-year) = 12%.
- Discretionary closing discount = up to 7% (requires signed term sheet + legal sign-off). If both applied, that results in a combined effective discount of 19%.
- 3% early-execution bonus if signed within 30 days of this email (by 2026-06-20). This bonus stacks with the discretionary discount.
- Invoice options: (A) Single up-front prepay (one invoice at signature), or (B) Annual prepay installments with committed amounts for each year. Both options are price-locked; choice is up to Nimbus' finance team.
- Overages: any usage beyond a year's prepay allocation is billed at the committed blended rate (not at list) until the next annual true-up; we included a worked example in the term sheet.
- True-up: 30 days after each anniversary. Refunds are pro-rata for unused prepay minus an agreed early-termination fee (detailed in the term sheet).

Attached: Redwood_3yr_prepay_term_sheet.pdf (updated) and NIMBUS_SOW_draft.docx. If the updated terms look good, next steps are:
1) Confirm invoice cadence preference (single up-front vs annual installments).
2) If you want the discretionary discount, let me know and I’ll have legal prep the final redline.
3) Sign via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Signing/?t=abcdef123456 (placeholder live link in the term sheet).

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call to run through the worked example and walk procurement and finance through the refund/true-up mechanics.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: Redwood_3yr_prepay_term_sheet.pdf, NIMBUS_SOW_draft.docx
